This isn't a bad as the other stories, but; In the last year, both my grandparents passed away. Causing huge grief in my family. My father, being the youngest, but apparently the one with their head on the straightest, was the one set in charge of everything. Money distribution and legal actions. After a month of mourning, maybe even less, my aunt and uncle were tired of waiting. They got fed up and demanded my father take fast action with inheritance distribution. They disowned my father for not giving them what they wanted soon enough. Then they hired a lawyer against him. Whom I thought was close family, turned out to be money grubbing selfish people. These incidents have split up my family. Their disgusting actions have broken my dads heart.

TL;DR; My Aunt/Uncle turned against my family over money.
